term: Lists of open-source artificial intelligence software
definition: These lists include projects which release their software under open-source licenses and are related to artificial intelligence projects.
details: These include software libraries, frameworks, platforms, and tools used for machine learning, deep learning, natural language processing, computer vision, reinforcement learning, artificial general intelligence, and more.
story: Imagine explaining a hard concept to a friend using nothing but a napkin and a pen. In plain words: These lists include projects which release their software under open-source licenses and are related to artificial intelligence projects. Here is how it actually plays out: These include software libraries, frameworks, platforms, and tools used for machine learning, deep learning, natural language processing, computer vision, reinforcement learning, artificial general intelligence, and more. A small mental model that makes a big tangle suddenly simple. And that idea, made concrete, is Lists of open-source artificial intelligence software.
